noise-generator.copy.body.translation: Sauti inacheza tu wakati wewe kuchagua. Kuanza katika kiasi cha chini ili kulinda kusikia; kucheza inategemea msaada wa kivinjari audio. Unaweza kuweka mitaa auto-kuacha timer.

noise-generator.copy.description.translation: Kuzalisha nyeupe, pink au kahawia kelele ndani na kiasi laini na chaguo-auto-stop timer.
